verses.pali: “Savedanā, bhikkhave, uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, no avedanā.
verses.english: “Bad, unskillful qualities, mendicants, arise with feeling, not without feeling.

verses.pali: Tassāyeva vedanāya pahānā evaṁ te pāpakā akusalā dhammā na hontī”ti.
verses.english: By giving up that feeling, those bad, unskillful qualities do not occur.”
